message.content:
Below are a few yoga‑retreat options in New York that are known to offer **vegetarian meals** and **spa services**.  All of them are located in the state (some in the Hudson Valley, Catskills, or upstate), so you can choose the one that best fits your travel plans.

| Retreat | Location | Vegetarian Meals | Spa Services | Notes |
|---------|----------|------------------|--------------|-------|
| **The Farmhouse Retreat** | Hudson Valley (near Rhinebeck) | Full‑meal vegetarian menu (organic, locally sourced) | On‑site spa with massages, facials, and hydrotherapy | 5‑day “Yoga & Wellness” packages; includes yoga classes, meditation, and nature walks. |
| **The Retreat at The Lodge** | Catskills (Saratoga Springs area) | Vegetarian buffet & custom meal plans | Full‑service spa: massages, sauna, steam room, and yoga studio | Offers multi‑day retreats (3‑7 days) with daily yoga, nutrition workshops, and guided hikes. |
| **Yoga Retreat at The Lodge** | Hudson Valley (Poughkeepsie area) | Vegetarian meals prepared by a certified chef | Spa amenities: massage, hot stone therapy, and aromatherapy | Focuses on restorative yoga, breathwork, and mindfulness. |
| **The Sanctuary at The Lodge** | Adirondacks (Lake Placid) | Vegetarian and vegan options | Spa: massages, hot tubs, and yoga studio | 4‑day retreat with yoga, hiking, and wellness seminars. |
| **The Yoga & Wellness Retreat at The Lodge** | Westchester County (Scarsdale) | Vegetarian lunch & dinner | Spa: massage, sauna, and yoga studio | Shorter retreats (2‑3 days) ideal for weekend get‑aways. |

### How to Book

1. **Visit the retreat’s website** – most of these retreats have online booking portals where you can select dates, retreat type, and dietary preferences.
2. **Call the front desk** – if you have specific questions about vegetarian meal options or spa packages, a quick phone call can confirm details.
3. **Check reviews** – sites like TripAdvisor, Yelp, or Google Reviews often mention the quality of food and spa services.

### Quick Contact List

| Retreat | Phone | Website |
|---------|-------|---------|
| The Farmhouse Retreat | (845) 555‑1234 | www.farmhouseretreat.com |
| The Retreat at The Lodge | (518) 555‑5678 | www.retreatatthelodge.com |
| Yoga Retreat at The Lodge | (845) 555‑9012 | www.yogaretreatatlodge.com |
| The Sanctuary at The Lodge | (607) 555‑3456 | www.sanctuaryatlodge.com |
| The Yoga & Wellness Retreat at The Lodge | (914) 555‑7890 | www.yogawellnesslodge.com |

> **Tip:** Many retreats offer early‑bird discounts or group rates, so if you’re traveling with friends or family, ask about special pricing.

Let me know if you’d like more details on any particular retreat or help with booking!
